verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Insomnia checking live responses against an OpenAPI contract to detect drift. The pack documents spec linting (`inso lint spec`), after-response scripting and collection runs, but these validate the spec itself or are general test primitives a user would have to build contract checks from. The MCP-to-Konnect 'validating' mention is a Konnect-side feature about requests, so it is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can validate live responses against the API contract to catch drift
